metadata.description: Live-captured with tools/mock-capture --allow-error-status against UEM 26.2 on 2026-09-24, inside a disposable sdktestrun org group, on an object deleted moments earlier (the org group was deleted afterwards and a second DELETE on it returned 400, quirk 20). Status, errorCode and message are verbatim except that the real resource id (in the path and the message) is replaced by a fixed id chosen to be unique in this corpus; the activityId is the capture anonymizer's output. Second DELETE /api/mdm/smartgroups/{id} on an already-deleted smart group: 400 with errorCode 400 (NOT the errorCode 6 the GET returns; see smartgroups_get_after_delete.json) and the same 'Smart Group not found with Id: <id> ...' message. client.IsNotFound accepts that message with errorCode 6 or 400 only.

body.message: Smart Group not found with Id: 46813 or User does not have access to it.
